title: Open pushforward vanishes off cohomological support
statement: Let X be a scheme, U and V opens, and T any subset of X with V disjoint from T. Use derived categories of module sheaves on X, U and their localized open sites [def-pc-derived-category]. Let F in D(O_U) have zero cohomology stalks at every point of U mapping outside T. Then R(U.ι)_*F [def-pc-derived-direct-image] restricted to the localized site at V is zero. Closedness of T, containment of T in U, and perfection of F are not required.

source.place: Lemma 08DP, computation on the complementary open, using Lemma 08FE

proof.text: Put W = U.ι preimage V. Import all Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.PerfectRestrictionClassesSmall and use its existing private helper hasDerivedCategory_of_equivalence with (Modules.overEquiv W).symm and (Modules.overEquiv V).symm to obtain chosen localizations on W.toScheme and V.toScheme in the same morphism universe. The helper transports localization along the exact equivalence; no duplicate transport theorem is needed.

For each homology module of F, restriction to W has zero stalks: restrictStalkNatIso identifies them with the original stalks and every point of W maps into V, hence outside T. TopCat.Sheaf.isZero_iff_stalkFunctor_obj_isZero and the faithful underlying-sheaf functor show that this restricted module is zero. Exact restriction commutes with homology; DerivedCategory.isZero_of_forall_isZero_homology makes the derived restriction of F to W zero.

Apply schemeDerivedDirectImage_openRestriction to U.ι and V. Its right-hand object is derived direct image of the zero restriction on W, hence zero by additive_rightDerivedFunctor. Transport this zero object through the comparison isomorphism, then reflect zero along the exact derived equivalence of Modules.overEquiv V. This gives zero on the over-site at V. For empty W or V the same zero-detection argument applies; for U=X it is ordinary restriction.

theorem supported_open_pushforward_complement_zero (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    (T : Set X) (V : X.Opens) (hV : ∀ x : X, x ∈ V → x ∉ T)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : U.toScheme.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace).over V))]
    (F : schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme)
    (hs : ∀ (n : ℤ) (x : U.toScheme), x.val ∉ T →
      Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) n).obj F).val.presheaf x))) :
    IsZero ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) V).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage U.ι).obj F))
